what.text: This page follows refugees from Russia living in Austria, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4053 Russian refugees in Austria, 4.1% of all refugees from Russia.
France hosts the most Russian refugees, followed by Germany, the United States and Austria.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Chechnya territory in Russia from 1994 to 1996 and from 1999 to 2007, and over Caucasus Emirate territory from 2007 to 2015.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2015 to 2020 and in 2024.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1998 at 180 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 19577, at the end of 2013; the main years of displacement in the data are 2007 to 2018.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Austria.
These are year-end totals for Austria only, reported to UNHCR.
